name: Necromancer: Lich Form keeps the Lich model after a relog
contract: Lich Form 500981 is saved and restored at login, and its apply hook casts the Lich model 504691 (MOD_SHAPESHIFT form 50). 504691 is passive, so it is never saved, and the hook runs while the character is still loading, where the cast is refused. A Necromancer who logs out in Lich Form therefore came back with Lich Form and its buffs 504747 but the normal model. After a relog the model aura and the Lich display must return, and cancelling Lich Form must still restore the normal display.

steps.label: SETUP: the Lich model is applied
